summary: Phase 5 Command Center Dashboard Frontend Testing Complete - All features working correctly. Verified Command Center page loads at /command-center route with 4 tabs (Overview, Engines, Modules, AI Guidance), track info header, quick stats, Next Steps, Blockers section, ARRIS/Millicent guidance tips, module activation/deactivation, and engine details modal.

passed_tests: === Command Center Page Load (8/8 passed) ===
Command Center page loads at /command-center route
Command Center title displayed
Track info header shows 'Creator Track'
Quick stats show: Engines Active (1), Modules Unlocked (9), Progress (9%)
Refresh button present and functional
4 tabs displayed: Overview, Engines, Modules, AI Guidance
Tab switching works correctly
Data loads from /api/command-center endpoint
=== Overview Tab (7/7 passed) ===
Quick stats cards displayed (Engines Active, Modules Unlocked, Next Steps, Blockers)
Next Steps section shows 4 recommended actions
Active Modules section shows currently active modules (Audience Builder, Platform Optimizer)
ARRIS tip displayed with structural guidance
Millicent tip displayed with tone guidance
No Blockers indicator shows 'All systems running smoothly'
View All Modules button navigates to Modules tab
=== Engines Tab (6/6 passed) ===
Engine Status panel loads with EngineStatusPanel component
4 engines displayed: Business Support, Audience & Visibility Support, Creator Identity Support, Monetization Support
Engine cards show status (Active/Inactive/Pending), progress percentage, inputs/outputs counts
Blockers displayed on engine cards (e.g., 'Requires business_engine to be active')
View Details button opens engine details modal
Engine details modal shows: status, progress, inputs checklist, outputs checklist, rules
=== Modules Tab (8/8 passed) ===
Module Status panel loads with ModuleStatusPanel component
4 sub-tabs: Active, Ready, Blocked, All
Active tab shows active modules with Deactivate buttons
Ready tab shows unlocked modules with Activate buttons
Blocked tab shows blocked modules with blocker messages and Resolve Blockers buttons
Module activation works - count changes from 5 Ready to 4 Ready after activation
Module deactivation works - count changes from 3 Active to 2 Active after deactivation
Module cards show: name, description, required engines, status badge
=== AI Guidance Tab (4/4 passed) ===
ARRIS Guidance panel displayed with 'AI Assistant' badge
Millicent Guidance panel displayed with 'Rule-Based' badge
ARRIS shows structural guidance (Logic, Clarity recommendations)
Millicent shows tone guidance (creative, encouraging approach)
=== Blockers Section (3/3 passed) ===
Blocked modules show specific blocker messages
Content Planner blocked: 'Define audience first for targeted content'
Community Manager blocked: 'Build initial audience first'
=== Integration Tests (4/4 passed) ===
Login redirects to /creator/dashboard
Navigation to /command-center works after login
API calls to /api/command-center, /api/engines/status, /api/modules/status succeed
Module activation/deactivation calls /api/modules/update/{module_id} successfully
